Description: The recall involves Kawasaki 2005-2006 model year KAF400 Mule 600 Utility Vehicles. These models are off-road utility vehicles available in red, green, or camouflage livery. They have "Kawasaki" on the side of the cargo bed and "Mule" on the side of the front cowling.
Title: Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A. Recall of Utility Vehicles
ConsumerContact: For more information, consumers can call Kawasaki Customer Service toll-free at (866) 802-9381 between 8:30 a.m. and 4:45 p.m. PT Monday through Friday, or visit the firm's Web site at www.kawasaki.com

Products.Name: Kawasaki 2005-2006 model year Mule 600 Utility Vehicles

Injuries.Name: Kawasaki has received 24 reports of the knuckle cracking or breaking. No injuries have been reported.

Retailers.Name: Kawasaki Utility dealers nationwide from November 2004 through December 2005 for between $5,900 and $7,100.

Distributors.Name: Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A., of Irvine, Calif.

Hazards.Name: The steering knuckle can twist or break from wheel forces transmitted to the steering system during operation. This can cause a loss of steering control and possible collapse of the front suspension, posing a risk of incident or injury to the operator or passenger.

Remedies.Name: Consumers with recalled utility vehicles were sent direct notice from Kawasaki. Consumers should stop using these vehicles immediately and contact a local Kawasaki Utility dealer to schedule an appointment for a free repair.
